subject: part
title: (R)PART.------AF.DYM.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 136 (T(AF)M-40). PART (participation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names AF-DYM; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From AFL-DY: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) and TH-CONT (thrust continuance), with the (PO) prefix, "point of". From PROJ-CONT: AFL (affinity alignment). From TH-CONT: PRI-INFO (principle information). From AFL: RC (race), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", and POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
